title: Collapse all closes every Tech View group and Expand all opens them
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). A desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • [User-A]: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • Two technicians at this location: "Esther Howard" and "Ralph Edwards" (the expected results name them, so keep these names). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Collapse All" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset, so this case's work orders are kept apart from every other work order at the location.
  • Three work orders for that customer: [WO-1] led by Esther Howard, [WO-2] led by Ralph Edwards, [WO-3] with no lead technician (sits in Unassigned).
  • Every Tech View group starts open (expanded) for [User-A].

Setup

  1. Sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page (you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  2. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm each technician below is active at this location with Time Clock on, or add it: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as "Esther Howard" (keep this name, the expected results use it); "Ralph Edwards" (keep this name, the expected results use it).
  3. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Collapse All" > Save (if it already exists, open it instead). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, TRK-118) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Collapse All" and its asset > Save. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open: in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; the build offers only ready-made lines), turn Line Approved on > Save & Close; the work order becomes Approved. Repeat for three work orders in all; record the numbers as [WO-1] (the expected results call it "S1-702"), [WO-2] (the expected results call it "S1-644") and [WO-3] (the expected results call it "S1-389") (numbers on this site look like "S10043-17581").
  5. Set the leads: on an Approved work order pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned. Here: [WO-1] = Esther Howard; [WO-2] = Ralph Edwards; [WO-3] no lead.
  6. If you collapsed any Tech View group before, open Work Orders > Tech View and expand it again, so every group starts open.
  7. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search ZZAUTOTEST F2 Collapse All > Tech View — Unassigned holds [WO-3], Esther Howard holds [WO-1], Ralph Edwards holds [WO-2], and every group is open. If not, fix the leads or expand the groups before starting.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab.
  3. Type ZZAUTOTEST F2 Collapse All in Search.
  4. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (tooltip "Tech View").
  5. Hover the button at the left end of the column-heading row, above the group arrows.
  6. Click that button.
  7. Hover the same button again.
  8. Refresh the page.
  9. Click the same button.
  10. Collapse Ralph Edwards' group only (arrow on his header).
  11. Click the button at the left end of the column-heading row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: the tooltip says the button collapses all groups (the design reads "Collapse all"). Write down the words you see; a different label alone is not a fail.
  • Step 6: every group closes at once, Unassigned included. Unassigned, Esther Howard and Ralph Edwards show only their headers, and their counts do not change (with the example data: Unassigned 1, Esther Howard 1, Ralph Edwards 1). Groups of other technicians with no matching work close too.
  • Step 7: the tooltip now says the button expands all groups (the design reads "Expand all").
  • Step 8: after the refresh every group is still closed, Unassigned included.
  • Step 9: every group opens at once and shows its rows again: S1-702 under Esther Howard, S1-644 under Ralph Edwards, S1-389 under Unassigned. The tooltip goes back to "Collapse all".
  • Step 11: with one group closed and the others open, the button closes every group. It does not open Ralph Edwards' group.
  • No work order changes group, the tab and the search text stay the same, and no message appears.
  • If the build has no such button in Tech View, mark the case Blocked with the comment "no Collapse all button in the build" so it can be raised with the product owner.

What you should see today (build v26.40.8-7a95011, 10/8/2026): Tech View has no "Collapse all" / "Expand all" button; each group has only its own collapse arrow beside its name. (1) If you see exactly that, mark the case Blocked (the developer says this part is not in this release) and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results above say, the change has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View — table grouped by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S2-R5, S2-R13, S2-R18, read 8 Oct 2026. Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Branko Cicovic, Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html): Tech View column-heading row button with tooltip "Collapse all" / "Expand all" (template line 34; label rule line 1304: "Collapse all" while any group is open, otherwise "Expand all"; toggleAll lines 980-986: closes every group when any is open, otherwise opens every group). Design crawl 8 Oct 2026, Tech View states 0-4, hover and click "Collapse all". The button is a design-only addition (the PRD neither asks for it nor rules it out); that the closed state is kept after a refresh comes from S2-R13. Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R5: “Allow each technician group to be collapsed or expanded.”
  • S2-R13: “Save group collapse state per user. It is kept after refreshes, logout/login, new tabs, and reopening the page.”
  • S2-R18: “Unassigned opens expanded unless the user collapsed it (S2-R13), and its header stays on screen while scrolling so it can be collapsed from anywhere. When it holds more work orders than fit on screen, which on the All tab can be thousands, it loads them in pages as the user scrolls, as List does, never all at once.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
